facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's latest update says all 6,427 public Level 2 to 4 facilities have completed the transition to HMIS and 4 public Level 5 facilities have migrated with 23 in progress, while the Level 6 hospitals KNH and KUTRRH had not yet completed it; no date is given for the update, so the document's published date is used.

The Ministry of Health says all 6,427 public Level 2 to 4 health facilities (6,427 of 6,427, a group that includes Level 4 hospitals as well as primary clinics) have completed the transition to HMIS; the update is undated, so the document's published date is used.

Health CS Duale says the hospital HMIS is to be the primary system through which healthcare services and information are managed, with data captured during the provision of care flowing to other systems and medical records, including scans, becoming accessible across facilities; stated as the intended arrangement, dated to the document's published date.

The government set 30 September 2026 for facilities to migrate from the SHA Provider Portal to HMIS and then extended the deadline to 30 October 2026, with all public Level 2 to 4 facilities reported migrated and 28 private HMIS platforms certified by the Digital Health Agency.

Duale describes HMIS as part of the government's own digital health infrastructure rollout, with the Digital Health Agency certifying platforms and giving facilities technical support, and the government supporting installation in 518 faith-based facilities; dated to the document's published date.

Duale says HMIS is not new but part of the government's digital superhighway rollout and an 'already paid-for suite of SHA systems'; he names no budget line or amount; dated to the document's published date.

systems.platform: government suite of SHA systems in public facilities; 28 certified private platforms
systems.owner: Ministry of Health / Digital Health Agency; private facilities run their own certified platforms
systems.tiers: public Level 2 to 4 (all 6,427), public Level 5 (4 of 27 migrated), Level 6 in transition, faith-based (38 of 518), private

systems.owner: introduced by the Digital Health Agency for the Social Health Authority
systems.tiers: contracted facilities; claims submission only, being shut down on 30 October 2026

note: Classed emr because this account says the hospital HMIS manages healthcare services, care data and medical records, not claims alone. The Level 2 to 4 figure is not split by level.
